events.description: A violent explosion/blast occurs at the right side of the store, sending debris and dust outward; this is consistent with a gunshot impact or nearby detonation in a confined space.
A bald man in black is seen from behind aiming a handgun toward the left; his posture and weapon orientation indicate active engagement in shooting.
The bald man is shown front-facing, holding a handgun with both hands, aimed forward—clear visual evidence of an active shooting stance.
The bald man again aims the handgun directly at the camera/viewer, with clear grip and sight alignment; this confirms ongoing shooting activity.
Two men engage in a close-quarters physical fight inside a convenience store, involving grappling, punches, and weapon disarming attempts.

A handgun is visibly held and pointed by one man toward the other; while no muzzle flash or bullet impact is seen, the weapon is clearly aimed in a threatening manner consistent with an imminent shooting attempt.
Two men engage in mutual physical combat: the man on the left throws a punch while the bald man on the right blocks or counters; motion blur indicates rapid movement and impact.
The two men are locked in close-quarters grappling, with hands on each other's shoulders/neck area, pushing and struggling—clear mutual physical combat without one being clearly helpless.
Two men engage in a close-quarters physical fight inside a convenience store, involving grappling, clinching, and forceful shoving against shelves and refrigerators.
After a brief pause, the two men resume fighting with a sudden upward motion, one man lifting or throwing the other’s arm/shoulder in an aggressive gesture.

Two men engage in a sustained, close-quarters physical fight inside a convenience store, involving grappling, punching, and throwing; the fight ends with one man subdued on the floor and a handgun visible on the ground.
A man with a bloodied face is held at gunpoint by another person; the victim appears helpless and distressed while the aggressor points a handgun directly at his head.

A bald man with facial blood is held at gunpoint by an unseen assailant; he displays escalating distress, pain, and fear (grimacing, teeth bared, eyes wide, mouth open) while the gun remains pressed to his head.
A man lies motionless on the floor of a store, with visible blood on his hand and debris scattered around; another man stands over him, suggesting an attack on a helpless victim.
